cardanoLegacyPcdRows.property: A Groth16 (BSB22 commitment-Groth16 in the bridge design) proof that a recursive inner proof verifies, with the inner VK/accumulator identity public, verified by a Plutus V3 validator that tracks the checkpoint thread.

For each action a of P: for all inputs and states, I(pre) and the guards of a imply I(post_a); one quantifier-free bit-vector validity query per action because /1 actions are straight-line. The certificate reports, per action, whether the guard conjunction is satisfiable over the scenario domain; a vacuous certificate (unsatisfiable guards, or a program whose every action refuses through conflicting identities, M-DISPOSITIONS F11 as quoted) is labelled vacuous and never satisfies a policy requiring PROP-01. Domain: all scenarios in the adapter's common subset (M-DISPOSITIONS RP-7 as quoted).
